title: Rosalind and the Letters
author: Dominic Joubert
blurb: Astrid Lockridge, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
